# GitHub Copilot instructions

Follow the project rules in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — they apply to every request in this repository.
Key team rules: **no regression tests**, and **the tester picks which test cases to run**.

- To generate test cases from a pasted Jira ticket, follow [instructions/generate-test-cases.md](../instructions/generate-test-cases.md).
- To update application knowledge, follow [instructions/update-knowledge-base.md](../instructions/update-knowledge-base.md).
